thread:
maria (Support): Morning — customer AcmeCorp reporting repeated invoice payments failing when SCA challenge fires. They sent PO and VAT; timeline tight.

sam (Payments): Need sample charge IDs and raw gateway body. Is this Hosted or Dedicated? Any pattern on BIN/country?

maria (Support): Hosted. Two IDs: ch_7Gx4tP and ch_7Gx4tZ. Gateway gave 402 with JSON payload:

maria (Support): ```json
{"error":{"type":"card_declined","decline_code":"challenge_timeout","acquirer_response":"AVS_MISMATCH","fraud_score":72,"3ds":{"auth_flow":"challenge","status":"timeout"}}}
```

alex (Eng): Looks like challenge started but ACS timed out. Our iframe wait is 20s; if ACS takes longer browser may abort. Do we have frontend traces for these attempts?

maria (Support): Trace tr_20261105_44 shows gateway latency ~16-22s and the client issuing a second polling call which extended total time >35s.

sam (Payments): AVS mismatch plus challenge timeout is classic when billing_address.country != card issuing country or PO/VAT triggers extra checks. Can you repro with and without billing_address and include PO in header vs metadata?

julie (Billing): Also note some EU VAT numbers cause additional verification. If merchant country != VAT country the acquiring bank may flag it. Is the VAT on the payload identical to their registration?

maria (Support): They sent metadata.vat=FR123456789 and billing_address.country=US in earlier attempts. When they omitted billing_address the same card sometimes passed auth (pending).

sam (Payments): Repro steps for debugging:
1) curl POST to /v1/charges with metadata.vat and X-PO-ID header
2) use EU test card token
3) capture trace id and gateway raw

sam (Payments): Example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/charges \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "X-PO-ID: PO-3221" \
  -d '{"amount":4500,"currency":"eur","card_token":"tok_eu_visa","billing_address":{"country":"US"},"metadata":{"vat":"FR123456789"}}'
```

alex (Eng): If we can confirm ACS consistently > our iframe timeout, I'll propose extending the client iframe wait by +10s and add server-side handling for challenge_timeout to avoid double polling. Need QA but it's a short term fix.

maria (Support): Ran repro, trace tr_20261105_45. Gateway returned AVS_FAILED then CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT. Link: https://console.redwood.com/traces/tr_20261105_45

julie (Billing): For immediate mitigation—advise customer to either match billing_address country to card or try payer using a card issued in their billing country. We can also offer to loosen strict AVS checks on their merchant account for this billing cycle (requires approvals).

sam (Payments): Opening gateway ticket with both charge IDs, asking for full AVS logs and ACS timings. CCing @alex. Inc created: INC-20261105-3DS-AVS.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20261105-3DS-AVS created and assigned to sam (Payments), priority P2.

maria (Support): Customer will try alternate card and resend logs. I'll update once they confirm.

alex (Eng): If this recurs across customers, we should evaluate moving to an adaptive timeout and better client-side handling of mid-challenge poll requests.

sam (Payments): Thanks — I'll report back from gateway. If anyone sees a spike in ACS latency, ping me.
